cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Make the Second Step First
cards.instruction: Get them to accept a small consequence that makes the larger risky action feel already underway.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I put a coin in the locker like the instructor. Put your bag beside mine before we discuss the climbing wall.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She was testing a broken lock. You've paid for a locker we can't open.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, equipment checked. Ask her to release our bags after the safety talk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can attend a safety talk. I'm not agreeing to climb.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. With our bags locked away, we might as well put the harnesses on while we're listening.
